CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to content is present.

COD.rationale: Content coordinates (red) are listed and the same referent has an origin/status entry; organization (pattern of coordinates) and a separate status/origin are both explicitly present.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-change claim linked to the same content's presentation/access.

C.rationale: The report explicitly identifies content (the set of red coordinates) for a named referent.

D.rationale: An origin/status entry is listed separately from the content coordinates for the same referent, distinguishing identification from status/source.

O.rationale: The content is presented as an explicit organized pattern (the full set of coordinate positions) for the named referent.
